title: Yoisaki Kanade — We're Forgetting Something〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Those people must be the ones who watch it immediately after receiving an upload notification.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I guess there really are people waiting for us to release new videos.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I know it's a little early, but why don't we call things here today since there doesn't seem to be anything wrong with the upload.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okay! So, what's our next song gonna be like?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry, I'm still working on the demo for it. Please feel free to take tomorrow and the day after off if you like.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <In other words, it'll be ready the day after tomorrow♪ I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Me neither. In the meantime, I guess I'll try working on some personal stuff.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, please do.
I'll let you know if anything comes up.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Phew...
Thank you for all your hard work, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Are you going to keep working after this, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, since I'd like to have a rough demo done tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mafuyu seems really at ease whenever we're all working together. So, I should probably try to finish this as soon as I can...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If I can have this ready by tomorrow afternoon, the others can listen to it and...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, umm... I was thinking about our next song, but I feel like I'm forgetting something.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, yes. That might be it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess I forgot since Mizuki or Ena are the ones who usually bring it up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, it is a little strange how neither of them have brought it up yet.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sure they're busy, since there's less than one week left before Kamiyama High's school festival...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I also forgot about that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... What should we do about our after-party...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We can throw one or not. I don't mind either way...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But they both seem to still be on Nightcord, so why not try asking them?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd rather not have them come back and ask, “Why didn't either of you say anything?”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They are always looking forward to our after-parties.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry, but we forgot to talk about our after-party. What should we do?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now we just need to wait for them to respond...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think they're back on call, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, you're right...
Let's see... Where'd the call button go...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Enanan? Amia?
Sorry for making you two come back.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<No, I'm also sorry.
I totally forgot about our after-party because I've been so busy with my assignments for art class.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And I forgot because of the school festival.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<That's less than one week away, yes?
If you're both too busy, then we don't have to throw one...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, we have to throw one! It's one of the few times we get to talk in person!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha! See how fast she jumped on that?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But I agree. I wanna throw one too, especially since K doesn't get out much otherwise.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I don't think that should be much of a consideration... But anyway, we'll be throwing an after-party as always.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Still, it's getting pretty late.
Why don't we pick this up again when we're listening to the new demo?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you. Anyway, we'll see you later.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Phew...
I fear that I'm going to forget about our after-party while working on this demo.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll remind you about it if you do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'd really appreciate that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to get working on our new song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(For Mafuyu's sake...
And for the sake of everyone who looks forward to our videos.)
